finalMessage: It depends on two facts these words can't show: whether the class makes any other word agree with the noun, and whether -na and -ta differ in meaning. A class with no agreement and no meaning difference is an inflection class; one that drives agreement is a feature (Black's Table 9). The single words here show neither, so one question decides it. I have changed nothing pending your answer. In a sentence with bituna and in one with daputa, does any other word change to match the noun, for example the verb, a word like 'this', or a describing word?
